import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    static String input() throws IOException {
        return br.readLine().trim();
    }

    static int INT() throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(input());
    }

    static List<Integer> LIST() throws IOException {
        st = new StringTokenizer(input());
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>();
        while (st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            list.add(Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()));
        }
        return list;
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int n;
        List<List<int[]>> graph;
        int[] level;
        int[] iter;

        MaxFlow(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            graph.get(u).add(new int[]{v, cap, graph.get(v).size()});
            graph.get(v).add(new int[]{u, 0, graph.get(u).size() - 1});
        }

        void bfs(int s) {
            level = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
            queue.offer(s);
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                int v = queue.poll();
                for (int[] e : graph.get(v)) {
                    int to = e[0], cap = e[1];
                    if (cap > 0 && level[to] < 0) {
                        level[to] = level[v] + 1;
                        queue.offer(to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int flow) {
            if (v == t) return flow;
            for (; iter[v] < graph.get(v).size(); iter[v]++) {
                int[] e = graph.get(v).get(iter[v]);
                int to = e[0], cap = e[1], rev = e[2];
                if (cap > 0 && level[v] < level[to]) {
                    int pushed = dfs(to, t, Math.min(flow, cap));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        graph.get(v).get(iter[v])[1] -= pushed;
                        graph.get(to).get(rev)[1] += pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                bfs(s);
                if (level[t] < 0) break;
                iter = new int[n];
                int f;
                while ((f = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) > 0) {
                    flow += f;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int N = INT();
        int M = 3;
        List<Integer> A = LIST();
        List<Integer> B = LIST();

        int initialSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            initialSum += Math.min(A.get(i), B.get((i + 1) % M));
        }

        int size = 2 * M + 2;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(size);
        int s = 2 * M;
        int t = 2 * M + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            mf.addEdge(s, i, N);
            mf.addEdge(M + i, t, B.get(i));
            mf.addEdge(i, M + i, A.get(i));
            mf.addEdge(i, M + ((i - 1 + M) % M), A.get(i));
        }

        int maxFlowRes = mf.maxFlow(s, t);
        int res = N - maxFlowRes;

        System.out.println(res + " " + initialSum);
    }
}
